Pinned runtime dependencies for the original Folium export. Source URLs and checksums are in sources.json; CSS image/font URLs are adjusted to local filenames. Original library license files are retained. OpenStreetMap live tiles require an internet connection and are not bundled. Glyphicons Halflings are provided with Bootstrap 3; see https://getbootstrap.com/docs/3.3/components/ and https://glyphicons.com/.
